detail.title: Intex Cool Star HC 105 – 105 Litres Air Cooler
detail.overview: Long Air Throw | Multi-directional Cooling | Inverter-Compatible | Ice Chamber | 1-Year Warranty Overview Flaunting premium looks, the Intex Cool Star HC 105 is built for powerful, long-range desert cooling in large homes and open spaces. Designed to handle extreme summer conditions, this high-capacity air cooler delivers strong airflow, superior cooling efficiency, and dependable performance for prolonged use. With a large 105-litre water tank, the HC 105 ensures extended cooling hours with minimal refilling, making it ideal for living rooms, halls, offices, and commercial environments. The high-efficiency 3-side honeycomb cooling pads offer excellent water retention and deliver up to 25% extra cooling, while the 45.7 cm (18") fan blade pushes air up to 18 metres for wide and uniform circulation. Built with a shock- and rust-proof body and powered by a durable double ball bearing motor, this cooler is designed for long-term reliability. Its full inverter compatibility ensures uninterrupted cooling during power cuts, while the built-in ice chamber provides an instant cooling boost during peak heat. Product Highlights Large 105-Litre Water Tank The high-capacity tank supports long, uninterrupted cooling sessions, reducing the need for frequent refills during extended usage. Powerful 18-Inch Fan with Long Air Throw The large fan blade delivers strong airflow with an air throw of up to 18 metres, making it suitable for large rooms and open areas. High-Efficiency 3-Side Honeycomb Cooling Pads The honeycomb pads provide superior water retention and enhanced evaporation, resulting in faster and more effective cooling in hot, dry climates. Inverter-Compatible Operation Designed to run seamlessly on home inverters, the HC 105 continues cooling even during power outages or voltage fluctuations. Instant Chill Ice Chamber The built-in ice chamber allows you to add ice for an immediate drop in air temperature when summer heat peaks. Durable Motor & Body Construction Equipped with a double ball bearing motor and a shock- and rust-proof body, this cooler ensures long-lasting and reliable performance. Ideal For: Large living rooms, halls, offices, showrooms, restaurants, and open-plan spaces that require powerful air throw, extended cooling hours, and heavy-duty performance.
